title: MCP tool-schema mapper for Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, and non-tool fallback

labels.name: source:agent

labels.name: area:mcp

body:
Build one provider-neutral tool-schema mapper directly from `crates/app/src/mcp/tools::list()`.

## Scope
- Read the live MCP tool list (currently 70 tools across 22 modules) at runtime so tool schemas stay current.
- Convert each schema for three public API formats:
  - Anthropic Messages (`POST /v1/messages`): map each tool to `{ name, description, input_schema }` and handle `tool_use` and `tool_result` blocks.
  - OpenAI Chat Completions (`POST /v1/chat/completions`): map each tool to `{ type: "function", function: { name, description, parameters } }` with `strict: false` by default (`strict: true` rejects `"additionalProperties": { "type": "number" }` in `crates/app/src/mcp/accessory_tools.rs`). Support `POST /v1/responses` for Responses-only OpenAI and Codex models.
  - Google Gemini (`generateContent`): map tools into `functionDeclarations` with `parametersJsonSchema`. Rewrite JSON Schema type arrays (`["string", "null"]` in `cutter_tools.rs` and `["array", "null"]` in `cutting_tools.rs`) into `anyOf`, and strip `$schema`.
- Add a two-tier fallback for local models without native tool calling:
  1. Prompt-guided JSON mode parses one `{"tool": "...", "arguments": {...}}` block, validates it, and requests user confirmation before mutating edits.
  2. Read-only Q&A mode answers questions from project context when native tool calling is off.

Done means: Offline unit tests convert all live tools from `tools::list()` without error for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini formats, and validate prompt-guided JSON parsing plus Q&A downgrade.

Part of #1773
